title: Solid-State Batteries & the Ten-Minute EV Charge
description: Replacing flammable liquid electrolytes with ceramic and sulfide solids to double energy density, eliminate battery fires, and charge an electric car in the time it takes to buy a coffee.

title: Base Editing & Prime Editing: CRISPR's Precision Pencil
description: Moving beyond cut-and-paste CRISPR to chemically rewrite single DNA letters, curing sickle cell disease and inherited high cholesterol with one infusion.

title: Perovskite Tandem Solar Cells & Paint-On Power
description: Stacking cheap, printable perovskite crystals on silicon to break the efficiency ceiling of rooftop solar, and the durability problem engineers are racing to solve.

title: Phage Therapy & Viruses That Hunt Superbugs
description: Using bacteriophages, viruses that only infect bacteria, as living precision antibiotics against drug-resistant infections.

title: Superconducting Magnets & the Race to Compact Fusion
description: How high-temperature superconducting tape lets fusion reactors shrink from cathedral-sized machines to truck-sized power plants.

title: Liquid Biopsies & Detecting Cancer From a Blood Draw
description: Reading fragments of tumor DNA floating in the bloodstream to catch dozens of cancers years before symptoms appear.

title: Dexterous Robot Hands & Tactile Sensing Skin
description: Why picking up an egg is harder for robots than playing chess, and how electronic skin with thousands of pressure sensors is finally giving machines a sense of touch.

title: Direct Air Capture & Turning Carbon Dioxide Into Stone
description: Giant chemical sponges that pull CO2 straight out of the sky and mineralize it into rock deep underground, and the brutal energy math behind it.

title: Pig-to-Human Xenotransplantation & Ending the Organ Waitlist
description: Gene-edited pig kidneys and hearts engineered to avoid human immune rejection, and what the first long-term patients are teaching surgeons.

title: Quantum Error Correction & the Logical Qubit Milestone
description: Why quantum computers are so fragile, and how bundling many noisy physical qubits into one reliable logical qubit unlocks useful quantum machines.

title: Graphene Membranes & Low-Energy Desalination
description: Atom-thin sieves with precisely sized pores that let water molecules through while blocking salt, slashing the energy cost of drinking water from the sea.

title: Precision Fermentation & Animal-Free Dairy
description: Programming yeast to brew real milk proteins, egg whites, and collagen in steel tanks without a single cow or chicken.

title: Solid-State LiDAR & How Self-Driving Cars See the Road
description: From spinning rooftop buckets to chip-sized laser scanners: how autonomous vehicles build a 3D map of the world millions of times per second.

title: GLP-1 Medicines & the Science of Appetite Rewiring
description: How gut hormone mimics quiet the brain's food noise, and the surprising effects researchers are seeing on addiction, heart health, and inflammation.

title: Orbital Solar Stations & Microwave Beaming to Earth
description: Collecting uninterrupted sunlight in orbit and beaming it to Earth as microwaves, and why falling launch costs suddenly make it plausible.

title: Plastic-Eating Enzymes & Infinite Recycling
description: Engineered enzymes that unzip PET plastic back into its original building blocks so bottles can be remade forever without quality loss.

title: Powered Exoskeletons & Restoring Human Mobility
description: Wearable robotic suits that help stroke survivors walk again and protect warehouse workers' backs, and the control systems that read your intent.

title: Superhot Rock Geothermal & Drilling With Plasma
description: Vaporizing rock with millimeter-wave beams to drill twenty kilometers down, tapping the planet's heat for clean power anywhere on Earth.

title: Smart Contact Lenses & Displays on Your Eyeball
description: Micro-LED displays, glucose sensors, and wireless power squeezed into a soft contact lens, and the engineering of building electronics you can blink on.

title: Cultivated Meat & Growing Steak From Cells
description: Growing real animal muscle and fat from a few cells in bioreactors, and the scaffolding, cost, and texture challenges between the lab and the grocery aisle.

title: Regenerating Inner-Ear Hair Cells to Reverse Hearing Loss
description: Gene therapies and drug cocktails that coax the cochlea to regrow the delicate sensory cells destroyed by noise and aging.

title: Sodium-Ion Batteries & Energy Storage Beyond Lithium
description: Building batteries from the same element found in table salt to make grid storage cheaper, safer, and free from scarce mineral supply chains.

title: AI Protein Design & Custom-Built Enzymes
description: Generative models that invent brand-new proteins never seen in nature, from snake antivenoms to enzymes that capture carbon.

title: Lunar Ice Mining & Making Rocket Fuel on the Moon
description: Harvesting water ice from permanently shadowed craters and splitting it into hydrogen and oxygen to turn the Moon into a gas station for deep space.

title: Self-Healing Concrete & Living Building Materials
description: Concrete laced with dormant bacteria that wake up when cracks let in water and seal the damage with limestone.

title: Small Modular Nuclear Reactors & Factory-Built Power Plants
description: Shrinking nuclear plants into standardized modules built on assembly lines, passive safety physics, and what it means for data centers and towns.

title: Optical Atomic Clocks & Redefining the Second
description: Clocks so precise they would not lose a second over the age of the universe, and how they can detect tiny changes in gravity and elevation.

title: The Glymphatic System & How Sleep Washes the Brain
description: The nightly fluid rinse that clears metabolic waste from the brain during deep sleep, and its links to Alzheimer's prevention.

title: Green Hydrogen Electrolyzers & Decarbonizing Steel
description: Splitting water with renewable electricity to make hydrogen, and using it to replace coal in steelmaking, one of the world's dirtiest industries.

title: Metamaterials & Bending Light Around Objects
description: Engineered structures smaller than a wavelength that steer light, sound, and radio waves in ways no natural material can, from flat lenses to invisibility cloaks.

title: Thermal Batteries & Storing Electricity as Red-Hot Heat
description: Charging blocks of brick or graphite to over a thousand degrees with cheap solar power and releasing that heat on demand for factories.

title: 3D Bioprinting & Lab-Grown Transplant Tissue
description: Printing living cells layer by layer with blood vessel networks to build skin, cartilage, and eventually whole organs.

title: Planetary Defense & Nudging Asteroids Off Course
description: How spacecraft impacts, gravity tractors, and early-warning telescopes protect Earth from rogue space rocks.

title: Vertical Farming & LED Light Recipes for Crops
description: Growing leafy greens and strawberries in stacked indoor towers with tuned LED spectrums, using ninety-five percent less water.

title: Mass Timber Skyscrapers & the Return of Wooden Cities
description: Cross-laminated engineered wood that is fire-resistant, earthquake-friendly, and locks away carbon instead of emitting it like steel and concrete.

title: Haptic Technology & Sending Touch Over the Internet
description: Ultrasound mid-air haptics and vibrotactile gloves that let surgeons, gamers, and families feel texture and pressure remotely.

title: Fully Reusable Rockets & the Collapsing Cost of Orbit
description: Catching boosters mid-air and refueling ships like airliners, and how cheaper launches reshape science, communications, and manufacturing.

title: Digital Twins & Simulating Entire Cities
description: Live virtual replicas of factories, power grids, and cities that let engineers test floods, traffic, and failures before they happen.

title: Engineered Gut Microbes as Living Medicine
description: Designer probiotic bacteria that sense disease inside the intestine and produce therapeutic molecules on the spot.

title: Post-Quantum Cryptography & the Encryption Deadline
description: Why future quantum computers threaten today's internet security and how new lattice-based math is being rolled out to protect banking and messaging.

title: Synthetic Biology & Cellular Logic Gates
description: Programming living cells like computer code to hunt down diseases, manufacture clean fuels, and heal human tissues.

title: Cloud Seeding, Weather Modification & Hail Prevention
description: Coaxing rain and snow from clouds with silver iodide and drones, what the evidence really shows, and the ethics of tinkering with weather.

title: AI Weather Forecasting & Predicting Storms in Seconds
description: Machine learning models that out-forecast billion-dollar supercomputer simulations on a single chip, and what that means for hurricane warnings.

title: Autonomous Coding Agents & the Changing Job of a Software Engineer
description: AI agents that plan, write, test, and debug software across whole codebases, and how developers are adapting their workflows.

title: On-Device AI & Small Language Models in Your Pocket
description: Compressing capable models to run privately on phones and laptops without the cloud, using quantization and distillation.

title: Robot Foundation Models & Teaching Machines General Skills
description: Training one AI brain on millions of robot demonstrations so it can fold laundry, load dishwashers, and adapt to new homes.

title: AI-Discovered Drugs Entering Clinical Trials
description: How AI is shortening the decade-long path from molecule to medicine, and the first AI-designed drugs being tested in patients.

title: AI Video, Deepfake Detection & Invisible Watermarks
description: The arms race between ultra-realistic generated video and the content credentials and watermarking systems built to prove what is real.

title: AI Materials Discovery & Millions of New Crystals
description: Models predicting stable new materials for batteries, solar cells, and chips, and the robotic labs that synthesize them.

title: Self-Driving Science Labs & AI That Runs Experiments
description: Closed-loop laboratories where AI designs experiments, robots run them overnight, and results feed straight back into the next hypothesis.

title: AI Mathematicians & Machine-Checked Proofs
description: Language models paired with formal proof assistants that solve olympiad problems and help verify new mathematics.

title: AI Radiology & Reading Medical Scans Alongside Doctors
description: How AI second readers catch missed tumors on mammograms and CT scans, and the safeguards hospitals use to deploy them.

title: AI Tutors & Personalized Learning for Every Student
description: Patient, always-available tutoring systems that adapt to how each student learns, and what early classroom studies show.

title: Real-Time Speech Translation & the Fading Language Barrier
description: Earbuds and phones that translate conversations instantly while preserving the speaker's own voice and tone.

title: AI's Electricity Appetite & Rewiring the Power Grid
description: How the explosion in AI computing is reshaping energy demand, and the grid upgrades, nuclear deals, and efficiency tricks racing to keep up.

title: Multimodal AI Assistants That See, Hear & Remember
description: Assistants that understand live camera feeds, voice, and long-term context, and the privacy questions that come with them.
